scope: Historical attempt 3 only: first successful engine initialization and full-model execution in a real fresh Fiji installation; bounded validation only.

github.identity_provenance: Verified IDs provided by parent artifact reviewer; source commit independently matches source-and-host.log and paired_overlays.

raw_status_policy: Raw PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED values are preserved. Qualification is separate from raw status, including ganglia_command FAIL whose description overstates the stage reached.

portable_transformation.retained: Stage statuses, errors, runtime, class_sources, dialogs, metrics, source excerpts, exact engine/model hashes and inventory differences. Original full reports and maps remain unchanged inside the ZIP.

recorded_report.scope: Paired bounded installed-Fiji validation, not all GAT workflows

official_updater.note: Supported updater resolution; live sites are inventory-locked, not a replayable historical snapshot

ganglia_engine_setup.note: Shipped JDLL installer plus exact pinned official native CPU jar; completed full model inference before copying either installation

ganglia_command.note: Real installed-Fiji GAT command; original observation is separately recorded in original_ganglia.json

opencl_workflows.reason: Native virtual M1 runner has no exposed OpenCL devices; requires a physical-device lane

full_interactive_workflows.reason: Biological review, parameter UI, every workflow, and physical-Mac Finder/Gatekeeper first-open are outside this bounded lane

recorded_report.interpretation: PASS applies only to a named completed stage. Original failures are observations, not automatically a successful before/after claim. No all-workflow PASS is possible in this lane.
